UAE.working_week: Monday to Friday (Saturday & Sunday weekend). Note: Friday working hours are usually half-day or observe midday break (12:00 PM – 2:30 PM) for Friday prayers.
UAE.greeting_style: Polite, formal, and respectful business English. Use 'Dear Mr./Ms. [Last Name]'. Warm cordiality is appreciated before diving into contract details.
UAE.payment_terms: Standard: 30% advance deposit via TT, 70% against shipping documents (Bill of Lading) or Irrevocable Letter of Credit (LC at Sight) issued by reputable UAE banks (e.g., Emirates NBD, FAB). Invoicing in AED or USD is standard.
UAE.holidays: Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, UAE National Day (Dec 2–3), Commemoration Day (Nov 30 / Dec 1), Islamic New Year. During Ramadan, business working hours are reduced by 2 hours daily.
UAE.negotiation_notes: Buyers appreciate clarity on Incoterms (CIF Jebel Ali or FOB Mumbai/Nhava Sheva). Expect respectful counter-offers and inquiries on sample availability, CEPA duty benefits, and lead-time guarantees.

Saudi Arabia.working_week: Sunday to Thursday (Friday & Saturday weekend). Avoid scheduling business calls during Friday prayer hours.
Saudi Arabia.greeting_style: Formal and deferential tone. Relationship-building is essential.
Saudi Arabia.payment_terms: Confirmed Irrevocable LC at Sight or 30-50% advance TT with balance against B/L.
Saudi Arabia.holidays: Foundation Day (Feb 22), Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Saudi National Day (Sep 23).
Saudi Arabia.negotiation_notes: Value personal trust and certifications (SASO/SABER compliance).
